algorithm: Compute target transitive closure over mandatory computation edges and explicit evidence/claim dependencies.
For each reachable node, mark RECONSTRUCTABLE only if a validated exact replay recipe exists and all of that recipe's own roots are resolvable.
Collapse reconstructable derived nodes into their irreducible ancestor roots.
Union policy-pinned nodes required by publication/claim/review status.
Return REQUIRED_ROOTS, OPTIONAL_EXPENSIVE_CACHE, OPTIONAL_CACHE, EPHEMERAL, and UNRESOLVED.
definition: For a target set T of runs/results/claims/releases, the logical minimum preservation set is the smallest set of non-reconstructable required nodes whose retention plus frozen recipes/source/environment permits exact reconstruction of every target under declared acceptance rules.
optimization_note: Logical minimality is separate from practical storage optimization; keeping expensive caches is allowed without pretending they are epistemically necessary.
safety: The algorithm is advisory until an independent replay from the proposed root set passes. gc may not use a minimum set that lacks a successful reconstruction proof.
